name: A list of objects for a list of primitives is not written
comment: The frontend checks that the items of the target are objects, keeps the list and logs a warning. The backend merges row by row and removes the rows beyond the result. With the generated wrapper, setting numbers[0].v sets numbers[0] to 1 without a warning, so the list becomes [1]. With the reflection wrapper, the set fails with a warning, so the list becomes [2].
